Function to calculate features matrix

Source: R/get-features.R
get_features.Rd

This function takes input from raw 990 Part IV, VI, and XII, then output a original data frame appended with columns as features needed to calculate governance score.

Usage

get_features(dat)

Arguments

dat

A data.frame containing columns ORG_EIN and correct inputs from 990 Part IV, VI, and XII. See details below. ORG_EIN must be a character string of 9 digits. (This data.frame can contain other columns). See details below for which variable from the 990 efile data must be included to run this function.

Value

A data.frame appended with features needed to run the get_scores function.

Details

990 Efiler data can be downloaded from the NCCS website here. Documentation for the 990 Efiler data can be found here with the data dictionary found here.

These are the variables from each Part/Schedule that are needed as inputs to run this function:

Variables from Part IV:

  • F9_04_AFS_IND_X

  • F9_04_AFS_CONSOL_X (recommended; see below)

  • F9_04_BIZ_TRANSAC_DTK_X

  • F9_04_BIZ_TRANSAC_DTK_FAM_X

  • F9_04_BIZ_TRANSAC_DTK_ENTITY_X

  • F9_04_CONTR_NONCSH_MT_25K_X

  • F9_04_CONTR_ART_HIST_X

Variables from Part VI:

  • F9_06_GVRN_NUM_VOTING_MEMB

  • F9_06_GVRN_NUM_VOTING_MEMB_IND

  • F9_06_GVRN_DTK_FAMBIZ_RELATION_X

  • F9_06_GVRN_DELEGATE_MGMT_DUTY_X

  • F9_06_GVRN_DOC_GVRN_BODY_X

  • F9_06_POLICY_FORM990_GVRN_BODY_X

  • F9_06_POLICY_COI_X

  • F9_06_POLICY_COI_DISCLOSURE_X

  • F9_06_POLICY_COI_MONITOR_X

  • F9_06_POLICY_WHSTLBLWR_X

  • F9_06_POLICY_DOC_RETENTION_X

  • F9_06_POLICY_COMP_PROCESS_CEO_X

  • F9_06_DISCLOSURE_AVBL_OTH_X

  • F9_06_DISCLOSURE_AVBL_OTH_WEB_X

  • F9_06_DISCLOSURE_AVBL_REQUEST_X

  • F9_06_DISCLOSURE_AVBL_OWN_WEB_X

Variables from Part XII:

  • F9_12_FINSTAT_METHOD_ACC_OTH

  • F9_12_FINSTAT_METHOD_ACC_ACCRU_X

  • F9_12_FINSTAT_METHOD_ACC_CASH_X

Variables from Schedule M:

  • SM_01_REVIEW_PROCESS_UNUSUAL_X

Input values may be encoded as "true"/"false", "1"/"0", "X" flags, or blanks; blanks may arrive as NA or "" depending on how the tables were read. Blank or missing yes/no responses are treated as 0 (the governance property is absent), and the result does not depend on the blank encoding. Two derived features can still be NA when their inputs are genuinely unavailable: P6_LINE_1 (share of independent voting members, undefined when the voting-member count is 0 or missing) and P12_LINE_1 (accounting method, when none is reported); get_scores imputes these.

P4_LINE_12 (audited financial statements) is 1 when the organization obtained separate (Part IV line 12a, F9_04_AFS_IND_X) or consolidated (line 12b, F9_04_AFS_CONSOL_X) independently audited financial statements. This matches how the feature was coded when the factor model was trained. Earlier versions used line 12a only, which scored organizations audited on a consolidated basis as unaudited. If F9_04_AFS_CONSOL_X is not supplied, a message is shown and line 12a alone is used.

2023 index items

get_features() also appends the 16 practice items used by the 2023 governance index (model = "2023" in get_scores), coded 1 when the practice is present, 0 when absent, and NA when the question was left blank:

GI_REVIEW_AUDIT

financial statements compiled, reviewed, or audited (XII-2a/2b, IV-12a/b)

GI_AUDIT

financial statements audited (XII-2b, IV-12a/b)

GI_AUDIT_CMTE

audit committee oversees the audit or review (XII-2c; 0 if no review or audit)

GI_ACCRUAL

accrual accounting (XII-1)

GI_INDEP_MAJOR

at least half of voting members are independent (VI-1a/1b)

GI_MINUTES_BOARD, GI_MINUTES_CMTE

meetings of the board and of committees documented (VI-8a/8b)

GI_990_BOARD

Form 990 provided to the board before filing (VI-11a)

GI_COI, GI_COI_DISCLOSE, GI_COI_MONITOR

written conflict-of-interest policy; annual disclosure; monitoring (VI-12a/b/c; b and c are 0 without a policy)

GI_WHISTLE, GI_RETENTION

whistleblower and document retention policies (VI-13, VI-14)

GI_COMP_CEO, GI_COMP_OTH

independent pay-setting process for the CEO and for other officers (VI-15a/15b)

GI_990_WEB

Form 990 posted on the organization's own website (VI-18)

It also appends five risk indicators, coded 1 when the event is reported: RISK_INSIDER_BIZ (IV-28a/b/c), RISK_LOAN (IV-26), RISK_FAM_TIES (VI-2), RISK_MGMT_CO (VI-3) and RISK_DIVERSION (VI-5). They are not part of the index, because they record disclosures and exposures rather than practices, but are useful alongside it. The extra raw fields these items need are retrieved by get_governance_data; any that are absent are treated as blank, with a message.

Examples

# get data
data("dat_example", package = "governance")
set.seed(57)
keep_rows <- sample(1:nrow(dat_example), 200)
dat_example <- dat_example[keep_rows, ]

# get features
features_example <- get_features(dat_example)
